# T402 Protocol

> Open-source HTTP-native payment protocol for USDT/USDT0 stablecoins.

## Overview

T402 is a payment protocol that uses HTTP 402 status codes. Flow: client requests resource -> server responds 402 + PaymentRequirements -> client signs off-chain -> resubmits with signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header -> server verifies via facilitator and serves resource.

Architecture: Transport (HTTP, MCP, A2A) x Scheme (exact, upto) x Network (EVM, Solana, TON, TRON, etc.)

## Scheme Types

- exact: Fixed-amount transfers (EIP-3009 on EVM, SPL on Solana, TRC20 on TRON, Jettons on TON)
- upto: Up-to-amount authorization (EIP-2612 on EVM) [draft]
- exact-direct: On-chain transfer proof (NEAR, Aptos, Tezos, Polkadot, Stacks, Cosmos)

## Supported Networks (CAIP-2)

- EVM: eip155:1 (Ethereum), eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum), eip155:10 (Optimism), eip155:137 (Polygon), eip155:43114 (Avalanche), eip155:57073 (Ink), eip155:80094 (Berachain), eip155:130 (Unichain)
- Solana: solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp (mainnet), solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1 (devnet)
- TON: ton:mainnet, ton:testnet
- TRON: tron:mainnet, tron:shasta
- Others: near:mainnet, aptos:mainnet, cosmos:cosmoshub-4, stacks:mainnet, polkadot:91b171bb158e2d3848fa23a9f1c25182, tezos:NetXdQprcVkpaWU

## SDKs

- TypeScript (v2.5.0): @t402/core, @t402/evm, @t402/svm, @t402/ton, @t402/tron, @t402/near, @t402/aptos, @t402/tezos, @t402/polkadot, @t402/stacks, @t402/cosmos + HTTP frameworks (@t402/express, @t402/hono, @t402/fastify, @t402/next) + AI (@t402/mcp)
- Go (v1.9.0): github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go
- Python (v1.10.1): t402 on PyPI
- Java (v1.10.0): io.t402:t402-sdk on Maven Central

## Transport Types

- HTTP: 402 status code with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / PAYMENT-REQUIRED / PAYMENT-RESPONSE headers
- MCP: Model Context Protocol for AI agents (11 tools)
- A2A: Agent-to-Agent protocol

## Key Types

- PaymentRequirements: { scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra }
- PaymentPayload: { t402Version, payload, accepted, resource, extensions }
- PaymentRequired (402 response): { t402Version, resource, accepts[], extensions }
